title: Make validateApp require owner; pass package.json team from 3 apps (single mono PR; lib is inlined, no platformkit change)

summary: validateApp (libs/shared-contracts) now throws if app.team is missing; lib bumped to 2.0.0 (breaking). core-shell/billing/reports pass team from their package.json (platform/payments/insights, hardcoded literals since bundler has no JSON import). Single mono PR #1 merged, CI+CD green. Assumptions: shared-contracts is an in-repo inlined lib so no platformkit change/publish needed; README fake-bucket-name cleanup left out as lee called it a separate thing.
